before: A cap of two fifths of the sheet height limited both the authored top or bottom page margin and the header or footer height that pushed the body.
after: The authored page margin always holds, and header or footer height pushes the body by its full height, leaving at least one point of column.
reason: The change only affects per-page content-box layout geometry derived locally from each replica's document. It does not change shared document state, operations, or the synchronization format.
